items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of Sondernutzung permit
items.quote: Dafür haben Sie einen Monat Zeit, gerechnet ab der Bekanntgabe.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 13.04.2027; no separate 'Aufgabe zur Post' date is stated, so the letter date is treated as the posting date. Letter posted after 1 Jan 2025 by a general (non-tax) authority: delivery is deemed to occur on the 4th day after posting, counting calendar days and not moving for weekends/holidays (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG/HmbVwVfG analog). 13.04 + 4 days = Sat/Sun/... counted as calendar days: 14.04 (1), 15.04 (2), 16.04 (3), 17.04 (4, Saturday)? Recomputed: 13.04.2027 is a Tuesday, so 14.04=Wed(1), 15.04=Thu(2), 16.04=Fri(3), 17.04=Sat(4) -> deemed delivery Saturday 17.04.2027 (no移动 for non-tax authorities). One-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 VwGO analog, §§ 187, 188 BGB): the day of delivery is not counted; the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 17.05.2027. 17.05.2027 is a Monday (not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday in Hamburg), so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed.

warnings: The delivery (Bekanntgabe) date depends on the letter's own date being the actual posting date (Tag der Aufgabe zur Post); if the letter was actually mailed on a different, later day, the one-month Widerspruch deadline would shift accordingly — recommend checking the envelope postmark.

Recalculation shows 17.04.2027 (the deemed delivery date, 4 calendar days after the 13.04.2027 letter date) falls on a Saturday; since this is a general district-authority letter (not a tax office), the delivery date itself is not moved to the next working day, only the eventual deadline end-date is checked for weekend/holiday adjustment.
